title: Pointing Stick
description: A lightweight plugin that lets you point out locations with visual particle effects and audio pings. Simple, intuitive, and clutter-free!
body:
# Pointing Stick 🪄📍

**"Over there!"**
Stop struggling to describe which block you're talking about. Pointing Stick lets you instantly ping any location with visual and audio feedback.


---

## ✨ Features

- **The Pointing Stick**: A magical tool that highlights exactly what you're looking at.
- **Visual Accuracy**: Uses vibrant particle effects to highlight the **specific face** of the block you hit.
- **Audio Alerts**: Nearby players will hear a satisfying "ping" sound at the target location.
- **Clean Inventory**: Smart anti-clutter logic ensure you only ever have one stick. Dropped sticks are owner-locked and self-destruct if you already have a replacement.
- **Spam Protection**: Built-in 2-second cooldown to keep your server's chat and visuals clean.

## 🛠️ How to Use

1. Run `/pointingstick` to get your tool.
2. **Left or Right Click** while looking at any block within **50 blocks**.
3. Watch the magic happen!

## 🔐 Permissions

- `pointingstick.use`: Access to the command and the tool. (*Enabled by default for all players*)

## 📦 Compatibility

- **Version**: Built for Paper/Spigot **1.20+**
- **Java**: Requires **Java 25** (as per modern Paper standards)

## 🐛 Issues & Feedback

Found a bug or have a suggestion? Open an issue on [GitHub](https://github.com/JonathanBraver/PointingStick/issues)!
